name: iteratedDerivWithin_comp_const_smul
statement: ContDiffOn 𝕜 n f s) (c : 𝕜) (hs : Set.MapsTo (c * ·) s s) : iteratedDerivWithin n (fun x => f (c * x)) s x = c ^ n • iteratedDerivWithin n f s (c * x)

name: iteratedDerivWithin_smul
statement: 𝕜 → 𝔸} {g : 𝕜 → F} (hf : ContDiffWithinAt 𝕜 (↑n) f s x) (hg : ContDiffWithinAt 𝕜 (↑n) g s x) : iteratedDerivWithin n (f • g) s x = ∑ i ∈ .range (n + 1), n.choose i • iteratedDerivWithin i f s x • iteratedDerivWithin (n - i) g s x
